statements.t: The Company intends to support this business through distribution development, flavor innovation, packaging initiatives, fountain offerings and targeted marketing.

The Functional Health and Nutrition platform is intended to broaden the Company’s portfolio into products addressing consumer interest in nutrition, sustained energy, active lifestyles, metabolic health and healthy aging.
The Company is also evaluating a potential functional health product opportunity for a targeted launch in 2027, subject to product development, regulatory review and commercial considerations.
The Company expects to assess additional opportunities involving differentiated formulations, established brands and strategic acquisitions.

Management intends to cease HD9 sales before the applicable effective dates, consistent with its legal compliance obligations, and to wind down related inventory, distribution and commercial arrangements.
The Company does not currently expect to pursue further investment in HD9 products.
The company expects to cease all HD9 product sales in the fourth quarter prior to the ban coming into effect December 11, 2026.
The Company intends to continue to focus on additional opportunities to reduce product costs & freight and warehousing costs.
We intend to continue to look for clear return on investment from our selling and marketing expenses to drive profitable sales.
We intend to continue to look for additional opportunities to reduce our G&A costs.
We expect to continue to record a full valuation allowance on our U.S. net deferred tax assets until we sustain an appropriate level of taxable income through improved U.S. operations.

Our effective tax rate is based on recurring factors, including the forecasted mix of income before taxes in various jurisdictions, estimated permanent differences and the recording of a full valuation allowance on our U.S. net deferred tax assets.

As a result, management believes that period-to-period comparisons of results of operations are not necessarily meaningful and should not be relied upon as any indication of future performance or results expected for the fiscal year.
